nativeHost.source: Official release archive checked against checksums.txt and GitHub asset digest

limits: Controlled fixtures establish integration, persistence, scheduling and presentation, not model identity accuracy.
Only final-archive CPR 3.43.1 Linux x86_64 runtime was tested; 3.39.0 was the upgrade source for the original 1.3.1 package.
Host theme changes were applied through the temporary host theme store and checked against actual iframe CSS tokens; no production theme was changed.
Initial development archive used pre-inlined fonts rejected by native CSS assembly; the final archive declares and loads fonts as management resources.
An earlier native UI check used a detached Frame after reload; its six controlled calls are counted in the audit. The corrected complete UI check passed with the same final archive.
